This listing of Flowers, Ferns, Shrubs and Trees of the Keowee-Toxaway area of the Western Carolinas, believed to be the most complete study of this nature ever published, is furnished to you with the good wishes of D.—Power Company. Duke Power, long interacted in all aspects of conservation in the area it serves, hopes that the availability of this list will contribute to enjoyment of the heautiful Keowee-Toxaway by the thousands of visitors now becoming acquainted with the area.
